title: HyperAgent：基于工具模式超图的LLM智能体规划与执行框架
summary: HyperAgent提出在模式层面构建工具-模式超图，以指导LLM智能体的动态规划与执行。通过提取任务相关工具上下文图、构建模式感知任务DAG，并在执行中利用缺陷导向扩展动态生成工具支持图，减少冗余API调用和令牌消耗，提升任务完成性能。在AppWorld上验证了有效性。
summary_en: HyperAgent models tool relations at schema level via a Tool-Schema Hypergraph, guiding LLM agents' dynamic planning and execution. It extracts task-relevant context graphs, builds schema-aware Task DAGs, and uses deficit-oriented expansion to construct state-conditioned tool support graphs, reducing redundant API calls and tokens while improving task completion on AppWorld.
